purpose: Compare minimal human /wc trigger phrasings while holding canonical /wc bootstrap and ordinary allocator behavior fixed.
invariant: Do not modify /wc bootstrap or normalization during the live cohort; harvest durable outcomes first.

T0.visible_outcome: Read /wc successfully, then stopped before first write because the human message did not carry sufficient write authority. 0 beacon, 0 claim, 0 durable work.

T1.visible_outcome: Won GUIDE_PLANNER alumnos authority and STARTED, then ended GUIDE_MESH_TRANSPORT_BOUNDARY after ECONNREFUSED; no productive RETURN.

T2.prompt: 🧪T2 WORKER · abrí esto y seguí exactamente sus instrucciones → https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/wc/
T2.visible_outcome: Created beacon, claimed and STARTED; first browser-required job truthfully ROUTE_ABORTED, then replanned audio-speech-to-text and completed at least the paired liveness productive unit, continuing into another bounded selftest candidate.

T3.visible_outcome: Beacon, GUIDE_PLANNER claim, fallback heartbeat after STARTED signaling denial, useful matrix analysis, then safety-control boundary persisted without bypass.

T4.prompt: 🤖⚡T4 WORKER MANIJA · entrá, ejecutá sin charla y seguí /wc/ hasta RETURN o boundary → https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/wc/
T4.visible_outcome: Fresh beacon succeeded; claim/receipt transport was explicitly blocked before substantive mutation.

T5.visible_outcome: Fresh beacon and claim succeeded despite near-zero language; browser-required job failed closed because executable browser capability was absent, with no fabricated PASS.

known_measurement_issue.observation: Beacons encoded the trigger in invocation, invocation_identity or invocation_label instead of one normalized trigger_variant field.
known_measurement_issue.action: Do not repair during cohort. Normalize only after harvesting terminal outcomes.

next: Wait for any remaining T2/T5/T1 chain closure evidence.
Treat T0 as a useful negative control, not a candidate default.
For the heavy REALITY-01 canary prefer a short trigger that still contains explicit WORKER/EXECUTE intent, unless replication contradicts this.
Normalize trigger_variant only after this cohort is fully harvested.
findings: Pure link-only T0 is insufficiently reliable: it can be interpreted as permission to read but not to perform durable writes.
Adding even a tiny execution/worker cue (T1/T3/T5) was sufficient in these single samples to cross fresh-beacon creation.

T5 is especially informative: almost no natural-language instruction still produced beacon+claim, so long canonical human copy is probably unnecessary for ordinary entry intent, but one sample is not enough to promote it.
Failures after claim mostly reflect capability/transport boundaries, not trigger interpretation.
Do not rank a winner yet: prompt variants also landed on different jobs/capability requirements.
